statement: Owner-labelled direct-wired input windows map 22 digital controls to the existing native 0x42 button bits: A/B/X/Y=0/1/2/3; QAM=4, right-stick click=5, Menu=6, R4/R5=7/8, right shoulder=9, D-pad down/right/left/up=10/11/12/13, View=14, left-stick click=15, Steam=16, L4/L5=17/18, left shoulder=19, right/left trigger click=23/27. Each intended button had three observed press/release cycles except View, which had two after the owner reported one missed press. Trigger full travel reaches 32767; stick cardinal extrema reach +/-32767. This is device correspondence for these labelled windows, not universal calibration or Steam virtual acceptance.

applicability.revision: Owner-authorized retail direct-wired 28de:1302; physical revision not independently re-read
applicability.firmware: bcdDevice 0404 device-version marker; firmware attributes not re-read in each input-only reduction
applicability.scope: D9 bare metal, labelled physical sessions and known consumer operations only. No virtual Steam acceptance, universal firmware behavior, calibrated force or wireless result.
